verdict:
WATCH - FLAT into the print, and the enum change from red's REJECT to WATCH is the whole point of this adjudication: the resolving datum lands in five trading days, so permanent dismissal is the wrong instrument.

THE PRINT CLOCK IS THE BINDING FACT. PicPay reports Q2 on 2026-08-24 after the close, and that date is CONFIRMED from the issuer's own 6-K EX-99.1 of 2026-08-10 - the only date in this batch that is primary-confirmed rather than yfinance-derived. From 2026-08-17 that is five trading days, which puts this case inside the TEAM print-race window. The pre-print position is filed and unanimous across both benches and this adjudication: FLAT, no position, and specifically no resting GTC order, because a limit order sitting into an unresolved binary is accidental short-vol.

WHAT THE BENCHES ACTUALLY ESTABLISHED. The brief that reached this court was not court-quality evidence and both benches proved it: its tape layer was a day stale and inverted in sign (it called +7% into the print when the tape had broken -10.5% to $10.22 with no filing since the 08-12 13G); its market cap was back-solved to $1.48B when 129.59M shares at $10.22 is $1.325B, so the screen's own $1.38B was closer than the 'correction'; its headline '+45% NPL growth vs +17% book growth, 2.6x' is an arithmetic identity (1.236 x 1.17 = 1.446) that adds nothing to '7.2% to 8.9% on a book that grew 17%'; and it cited the 6-K EX-99.1 for NPL, Stage 3 and coverage figures that document does not contain - those live at best in EX-99.2 and in a CEO answer during Q&A. That last one is the FVRR error class repeating, and the issuer's own choice to publish the flow ratio (cost of risk 3.7%) in the vetted release while omitting the entire stock-ratio class is itself a finding worth keeping.

WHERE OUR OWN BENCHES ERRED. Red over-reached exactly where it mattered: it graded FATAL on a ratio that cannot discriminate, and blue is right that the correct sufficiency test - Stage 3 coverage in isolation against the NPL 90+ stock - is absent from every document either bench read. The honest state of the credit question is UNTESTED, which is weaker than the brief claimed and stronger than red allowed. Red also attributed the -10.5% print-eve break to lockup supply with no volume print for that day, no identity for the 08-12 13G filer, and a ~19-day gap from the ~29-July expiry - a narrative fitted to one bar; the flow gate still applies (do not bid into predicted supply) but the cause is UNVERIFIED. And both benches let the highest-value check go unrun: app_review_velocity on the PicPay app is dispatch-matched, is the desk's validated independent read on a consumer app's customer base, and uniquely here does NOT route through the defendant's numbers - which is exactly what an RP_TAINTED name needs. Both marked it UNCHECKABLE and moved on. Finally, the brief promoted RP_TAINTED from a sizing input to a verdict ('forces FLAT regardless of what a court finds'), which makes the court decorative; per the response taxonomy an integrity overhang caps size at 0.85x expected fair value, and here both benches agree the Section 11 tail is roughly 0.3-1.8% of market cap - immaterial in dollars, which means the overhang is purely epistemic and is resolved by independent evidence, not by waiting.

DIVERGENCE, NOT COVERAGE. Nobody killed on coverage here - red's use of the float and ADV data was the correct kind (2.04M shares/day against a ~21.4M free float turns the float every ~10.5 days, so 'structurally illiquid' was simply wrong and exit at desk size is a non-issue). But the divergence work is missing on the operative number: the file never states what the street models for Q2 NPL 90+, cost of risk, or adjusted net income against the company's own guide of R$3.6B managerial revenue, R$1.9B NII, R$1.15B gross profit and R$245M adjusted net income. That guide is a management number, not a street number; before the 08-25 reconvene, extract consensus and state ours beside it.

BETA-CARRIER DISCIPLINE ON THE GATE. The existing ledger alert (below $9.50) is correctly worded as watch-only, and it must stay that way. PICS trades on BRL and the EM-fintech complex as much as on its own book; a print through $9.50 driven by a currency or sector move carries no information about credit formation. Keep it as a review trigger, and let the entry decision be event-shaped: the 08-24 numbers, not the price that precedes them.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED - blue sustained red's presentational kills (the brief's stale $11.42/+7%-into-the-print tape layer, the '+45% vs +17%' tautology, the verdict-invariant-to-the-court self-contradiction, the re-anchored Section 11 statutory cap of ~$200.7M at $10.22) and overturned red's FATAL. Red argued under-provisioning has exactly one signature - falling coverage - and that Stage 2+3 coverage rising 1.9pp to 63.9% therefore kills the mechanism. Blue's counter is correct on the accounting: blended Stage 2+3 coverage is a MIX ratio, and a disclosed R$590M Stage 2-to-Stage 3 reclassification mechanically lifts the blended number even if Stage 3 coverage in isolation is falling, so the ratio cannot discriminate adequacy from mix. Blue kept red's IFRS 9 direction point (a book compounding 17% a quarter front-loads Stage 1 ECL into cost of risk while diluting the NPL denominator, so a flat 3.7% cost of risk through +116% book growth is the harder outcome, not the easier one), which damages the brief's concealment framing without exonerating the book. AUDIT NOTE per BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: blue had NO fetch capability this session - no sec.gov, no proxy, no IBKR - and says so first. Its overturn is an accounting-logic argument on figures both benches stipulate, not a replacement of a primary figure, so the re-fetch rule is not triggered; but it also means the decisive sufficiency test (Stage 3 coverage standalone against the NPL 90+ stock) exists in NO artifact in this file, from either side.
reopen_gates: PRINT, PRIMARY-CONFIRMED: 2026-08-24 after the close. Pre-committed gate, restated at the corrected tape: NPL 90+ <= 9.5% WITH Stage 3 coverage IN ISOLATION flat or rising (not blended Stage 2+3, which is the ratio that fooled the red bench) AND cost of risk no worse than ~4.0% without reclassification support -> the thesis reopens at <= 0.85x expected fair value (RP_TAINTED cap), starter <= 1% of NLV, tranched. NPL 90+ >= 10.5%, or Stage 3 coverage falling, or a flat cost of risk held up by visible Stage migration -> value trap, dismiss to AVOID.

ACTION OWED BEFORE 2026-08-24 (all three are cheap and were skipped by both benches): (1) run app_review_velocity on the PicPay app plus a Nubank/Mercado Pago control - the only read here that survives RP_TAINTED because it does not route through management; (2) fetch SC 13G accession 0001229262-26-000020 for holder identity - a >=5% Class A holder crossing on a 21.4M float five sessions before a binary is either the best buy signal or the best distribution signal in the case, and it has survived two benches as 'unresolved'; (3) pull the adjusted-net-income bridge, because adjusted NI guided to +45% sequential against gross profit +5% is itself a flag on the adjustment items (SBC, Kovr, one-offs) that neither bench audited.

DIVERGENCE (owed before the 08-25 reconvene): extract street consensus for Q2 NPL 90+, cost of risk and adjusted net income, and state our numbers beside them with the mechanism for the difference. The court currently has the company's guide and no street number - that is an anchor we control, which is the circularity the mispricing-artifact taxonomy warns about.

PRICE, REVIEW-ONLY (beta-carrier conditioned): keep alert_below 9.50 as a review trigger, NOT an entry. A break through $9.50 is actionable information only if it is idiosyncratic - i.e. BRL and the EM-fintech complex are flat or up on the same days. A currency- or sector-driven break tells us nothing about the credit book and must not be read as 'cheaper'.

EVENT: identification of the ~29-July lockup supply actually clearing (volume decomposition, or a Form 144/13D confirming the seller) - this converts red's flow-gate narrative from PLAUSIBLE to CONFIRMED and, once the supply is spent, removes the value-ladder objection to bidding.

STRUCTURE (unrun, dispatch-matched): pe_dividend_recap_pre_ipo was never run despite J&F being a controlling holder - the F-1 use-of-proceeds and any 24-month pre-IPO distribution to J&F bear directly on the Securities Act claim. Run before any starter.
process_findings: PRINT CLOCK - THE TIGHTEST IN THE BATCH: 2026-08-24 AMC, primary-confirmed, five trading days from 2026-08-17 (four from 2026-08-18). TEAM print-race discipline applies: the pre-print position is filed as FLAT, and the three owed pre-print actions must run before the print or the 08-25 reconvene will be un-evidenced.

HELD STATUS: NOT HELD. Ledger row exists (WATCH, court_gates, alert_below 9.5, watch-only). This draft KEEPS the gate as review-only and adds the beta-carrier condition (BRL / EM-fintech complex flat-or-up) so it cannot be mistaken for an entry level.
NO RESTING ORDER: a GTC into an unresolved binary print is accidental short-vol. Nothing may be staged before 2026-08-25.

BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: blue had zero fetch capability this session and states it first, capping its own conviction at 7. Its overturn of red's FATAL is an accounting-logic argument on stipulated figures, not a replacement of a primary number, so no re-fetch was owed - but the decisive Stage 3 standalone coverage appears in NO artifact from either side, which is why the verdict is deferred to the print rather than decided now.

DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE: no coverage-count kill was attempted; red's liquidity/crowding work is the correct use of discovery_state (it refuted 'structurally illiquid' with float-turnover arithmetic). The gap is the missing street number on the operative Q2 metrics - owed before the reconvene.

RP_TAINTED: J&F/Batista control plus a live Securities Act claim. Per the response taxonomy and the integrity-overhang gate this caps size at 0.85x expected fair value; it is NOT a classification that forces FLAT regardless of findings, and the brief's use of it that way is the reason red's finding 6 (verdict invariant to the court) is the structurally most important thing in this file.

SIZE: 2.04M shares/day at $10.22 is ~$20.8M ADV; a 1% position in a ~$1.03M book is ~$10.3k, i.e. ~0.05% of a day's volume. Size is a non-issue in both directions - delete 'structurally illiquid' from the record.

TAX: no distribution; Netherlands N.V. with Brazilian operations - if a dividend is ever initiated, Dutch withholding and treaty treatment would need checking before any carry is credited. Nothing load-bearing today; all return is capital gain and a starter opened after 08-25 carries a short-term clock.

TAPE DISCIPLINE: three different prices appear in the brief ($10.67, $11.42, $11.60) and none is the live one; the pack ($10.22, dd52 -0.488, +22.8% off the $8.32 low) is internally consistent and is what both benches and this adjudication use. A live IBKR quote is still owed before any gate is treated as fillable - search_contracts was permission-denied to both benches.

kg_candidates.name: blended_stage_coverage_is_non_discriminating
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - it caught a FATAL verdict resting on a ratio that cannot discriminate, which is the exact failure mode the blue bench exists for. The rule is general across IFRS 9 lenders and cheap to check.
kg_candidates.one_line: Blended Stage 2+3 ECL coverage RISING is not evidence of provisioning adequacy when a Stage 2-to-Stage 3 reclassification is disclosed in the same or a recent period - the mix shift alone lifts the blended ratio while Stage 3 coverage in isolation can be falling.
kg_candidates.fires_on: an IFRS 9 lender where a bench cites blended Stage 2+3 coverage as the sufficiency test, a Stage migration or reclassification is disclosed within the trailing two quarters, and Stage 3 coverage standalone is neither disclosed nor cited
kg_candidates.evidence_here: PICS Q1-26: blended coverage +1.9pp to 63.9% on rising NPL, ruled FATAL to the under-provisioning thesis by the red bench; the same record discloses an R$590M Stage 2-to-3 reclassification (+R$88M ECL) in the prior quarter, and Stage 3 coverage standalone appears in no document either bench read.

kg_candidates.name: vetted_venue_metric_class_omission
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT AS NARROWED - harvest as blue framed it: this establishes a citation defect and an issuer disclosure choice, NOT that the omitted figure is false. The valuable half is the issuer-behaviour signal (flow ratio published, stock ratio withheld from the vetted venue while the damaging trajectory lives in a Q&A answer).
kg_candidates.one_line: An issuer's FILED release publishes the flattering period-FLOW ratio while omitting the entire STOCK-ratio metric class, and the damaging forward guide for that class exists only in the unvetted transcript - the omission is the finding; the omitted number is not thereby false.
kg_candidates.fires_on: a credit/inventory/backlog issuer whose vetted exhibit discloses a flow ratio (cost of risk, provision rate, turns) but no corresponding stock ratio (NPL, coverage, aging, DSO), and whose forward trajectory on the omitted class is sourced only to an earnings-call answer
kg_candidates.evidence_here: PICS 6-K EX-99.1 (2026-06-02), proxy-fetched twice by red: discloses cost of risk 3.7% and portfolio R$28B and contains no NPL 90+, Stage 3 or coverage figure; NPL 8.9% and the 'low teens by year-end' trajectory appear only in EX-99.2 and the Q1 call Q&A, and the brief cited the EX-99.1 URL for all of them.

kg_candidates.name: integrity_overhang_is_epistemic_when_dollars_are_immaterial
kg_candidates.source: blue bench new finding C (PICS); adjudicator promotes it to a rule
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - it converts RP_TAINTED from a mood into a decision procedure and would have changed how this brief was written. Wire it into the RP_TAINTED handling path.
kg_candidates.one_line: When a litigation/integrity tail is small relative to market cap, the overhang is EPISTEMIC rather than financial - and epistemic overhangs are resolved by seeking evidence that does not route through management, never by waiting or by promoting the flag to a verdict.
kg_candidates.fires_on: an RP_TAINTED or integrity-flagged name where the bounded statutory/settlement exposure computes to less than ~5% of market cap
kg_candidates.evidence_here: PICS: Section 11 statutory cap 22,857,143 x ($19.00 - $10.22) = ~$200.7M gross, with a 2-10% settlement range giving ~$4-24M, i.e. ~0.3-1.8% of the $1.325B cap. Both benches agreed the dollars are immaterial; neither then sought the independent evidence (app_review_velocity, 13G identity) that the epistemic gate actually requires, and the brief instead used RP_TAINTED to make the verdict invariant to the court.

packs_to_arm.date_confidence: CONFIRMED BY ISSUER PRIMARY - 6-K EX-99.1 filed 2026-08-10 states verbatim that the company will report on August 24, 2026 after market close. This is the only date in the batch that is not yfinance-derived. Five trading days from 2026-08-17.
packs_to_arm.adjudication: Read strictly in this order and do not let the guide's headline beat overwrite the credit read: (1) NPL 90+ against 8.9% and the 9.5%/10.5% gate levels; (2) STAGE 3 COVERAGE IN ISOLATION - the sufficiency test that exists in no prior document; blended Stage 2+3 is not admissible; (3) cost of risk against 3.7%, and whether any Stage migration or write-off policy change is doing the work; (4) the adjusted-NI bridge against the R$245M guide - adjusted NI growing nine times faster than gross profit is either operating leverage or an adjustment story, and the bridge decides which; (5) portfolio growth against R$31.0B guided, since a decelerating book changes the Stage 1 front-loading dynamic that makes the flat cost of risk hard; (6) any disclosure of the 08-12 13G holder or further lockup supply.

branches.NPL <= 9.5% AND STAGE 3 COVERAGE FLAT/UP: the seasoning read wins; reopen at <= 0.85x expected fair value with a starter <= 1% NLV, tranched, and only after a live IBKR re-quote - the print itself will move the entry basis by more than a band.
branches.NPL 9.5-10.5% WITH STAGE 3 COVERAGE FLAT: unresolved again; stay WATCH, re-arm for Q3, and require the app-review read before the next court rather than after.
branches.NPL >= 10.5% OR STAGE 3 COVERAGE FALLING: the brief's mechanism is confirmed after all, on the correct ratio - dismiss to AVOID and log that the correct test was identified by the blue bench, not by the thesis.
branches.COST OF RISK HELD FLAT BY VISIBLE RECLAS: the concealment claim is validated in its strong form; AVOID and treat the issuer's disclosure choices as a standing integrity input.
branches.13G REVEALED AS INSIDER/J&F-AFFILIATE DI: supply is not spent and the flow gate hardens regardless of the credit branch; no bid until the distribution completes.
